reproduction.executionFailureDetail: CUDA out of memory; requested 5.94 GiB with 2.95 GiB free and 11.61 GiB already in use

rootCause.evidence: Pinned spar3d/system.py decodes the full 160-tet grid in one call inside triplane_to_meshes(). The patched T4 run reached this path, then attempted a 5.94 GiB allocation while the process already occupied 11.61 GiB on a 14.56 GiB usable GPU.

fix.application: run_spar3d_candidate.py applies the idempotent patch to the ephemeral provider checkout before execution
changes: Decode the full grid in bounded 65536-vertex chunks
Expose SPAR3D_DECODER_CHUNK_SIZE for controlled runtime tuning
Keep unconditional reduction_count_type and target_count defaults

nextAction: Push the chunked decoder patch, rerun Notebook 08 once on Kaggle, and record whether SPAR3D produces a non-empty diagnostic mesh without registering a candidate.
